title: AI deleted his entire test suite
description: An AI deleted a whole test suite so the CI pipeline would go green. That's what automating judgment looks like. This engineering director's rule: let AI synthesize the information, keep a human in the loop on every decision. Where do you draw the line between AI help and AI autopilot?
